entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker and dragon mage who returns to a new Tarkir of dragons after saving Ugin, finds no one remembers him, and learns that Narset has been killed as a heretic.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon lying within a hedron cocoon, whom Sarkhan resolves to wake.

entities.name: Vial Smasher
entities.description: A goblin Sarkhan knew as Ankle Shanker, now living with dragonfire vials in a Mardu encampment and not recognizing him.

entities.name: Zurgo Bellstriker
entities.description: A Mardu orc who strikes a great bell that calls dragons and who does not know Sarkhan; in Sarkhan's memory he was the khan who led the Mardu.

entities.name: Master Taigam
entities.description: A powerful, bald master at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary who calls Narset a heretic and throws Sarkhan out.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A Jeskai figure Sarkhan hoped would live in the new Tarkir, but who was punished as a heretic and is dead.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The sleek, agile dragon who rules the Jeskai territory as its oldest and wisest being, teaching his pupils.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: The ancient, fast Mardu dragon with a leathery fringe who leads her herd against Sarkhan's; she kills those who say 'khan.'

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon whose name Zurgo uses to dismiss Sarkhan's name as an 'Atarka name'.

entities.name: Yasova
entities.description: The Temur khan Sarkhan met in the past, whose attack on a brood he remembers.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The clan of the new Tarkir that lives alongside dragons and shares dragonfire.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan now ruled by the dragon Ojutai.

entities.name: Dragon's Eye Sanctuary
entities.description: The Jeskai tower where Ojutai perches and Master Taigam presides.

entities.name: Hedron cocoon
entities.description: The ice-covered stone cocoon of hedrons protecting the fallen Ugin.

entities.name: Dragon tempests
entities.description: The storms that birth dragons, still active in the new Tarkir.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane in its altered, dragon-filled present.

events.summary: Sarkhan is pulled back through time and finds himself before the weathered hedron cocoon, evidence that many years have passed.
events.quote: He was standing before the hedron cocoon, exactly where he had been a mere moment before

events.summary: Sarkhan sees a herd of dragons overhead and understands that the dragons survived, then transforms and joins them.
events.quote: And in his dragon form, Sarkhan Vol took to the sky.

events.summary: The herd roars with Sarkhan, and he sees changed land with five broods and new dragons from a tempest.
events.quote: As he shot back up into the herd, he was greeted by nothing less than the sight of a dragon tempest rupturing before him.

events.summary: A bell rings from a Mardu camp and an ancient dragon leads a herd of dragons up to meet Sarkhan; he sees the other timeline's rotting skull in her face.
events.quote: Shooting toward him was both the dragon of this now, flesh and blood and scales, and the dragon of the now that had been lost forever

events.summary: Sarkhan lands at the Mardu camp and is attacked by the goblin Vial Smasher, whom he knew as Ankle Shanker and who doesn't recognize him.
events.quote: You're here! You're alive! Just like the dragon.

events.summary: Sarkhan transforms to shield Vial Smasher from her own thrown vial of dragonfire.
events.quote: As it shattered on the ground, Sarkhan transformed into a dragon and dove in front of Vial Smasher

events.summary: Sarkhan meets Zurgo, now the bell-striker, who does not know Sarkhan and says no one says the word khan under Kolaghan Dragonlord.
Zurgo mocks the name Vol and raises his dull blade; Sarkhan flees into the sky, realizing no one knows him in this changed Tarkir.
events.quote: Both orc and goblin stood in paralyzed stillness as Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes Narset might be alive in this timeline and heads to Jeskai territory to find her.
events.quote: She would be here. She would be alive!

events.summary: Sarkhan learns that the dragon Ojutai rules the Jeskai and follows word of Narset to the Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
events.quote: He followed word of her name up and up, ever closer to Ojutai's roost.

events.summary: Master Taigam tells Sarkhan that Narset was a heretic punished to the full extent of the law and is no more.
Taigam throws Sarkhan down the stairs; Sarkhan flies off in despair, resolving to wake Ugin to repair the timeline.
events.quote: It was time to wake the Spirit Dragon.

relations.note: He presides at Ojutai's sanctuary, saying nothing is higher than Ojutai.
relations.quote: There is nothing higher except Ojutai himself.

relations.note: A dragon rules in Narset's stead over the Jeskai territory.
relations.quote: a dragon called Ojutai ruled in her stead.

relations.note: Dragonlord of the Mardu, killing those who say 'khan'.
They share the Mardu camp; she calls him a bad orc.
He saved Ugin and hopes Ugin will repair things.
relations.quote: Ugin would know how to make this right.

relations.note: He calls her a heretic punished to the full extent of the law.
relations.quote: She was a heretic, and for that she was punished to full extent of the law.
